chunk_view_0.name: chunk_view_0
chunk_view_0.body_sql:
SELECT
  RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID AS course_instructor_key,
  RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AS course_instructor_name,
  SUBJECT_TITLE AS course_title,
  TOTAL_UNITS AS amount_of_material,
  SUBJECT_ID AS subject_key
FROM course_catalog_subject_offered
WHERE RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL
  AND SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID, SUBJECT_ID, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, TOTAL_UNITS
chunk_view_0.description: Task: For each distinct course instructor (by course instructor key) and for each subject offered (by subject key), return the instructor's name, the course title, and the amount of material for that

chunk_view_2.name: chunk_view_2
chunk_view_2.body_sql:
SELECT
  lcr.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY,
  lcr.INSTRUCTOR_NAME,
  lrc.CATALOG_TITLE,
  lrc.RECORD_COUNTER,
  lro.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY,
  lro.SUBJECT_ID,
  lro.TERM_CODE
FROM library_course_instructor lcr
JOIN library_reserve_matrl_detail rmd
  ON lcr.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = rmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
JOIN library_reserve_catalog lrc
  ON rmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
JOIN library_subject_offered lro
  ON rmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lro.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
WHERE rmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY IS NOT NULL
  AND rmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY IS NOT NULL
chunk_view_2.description: Task: For each distinct course instructor (by course instructor key) and for each subject offered (by subject key), return the instructor's name, the course title, and the amount of material for that

chunk_view_3.name: chunk_view_3
chunk_view_3.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- instructor identifier (possible keys in this chunk: MIT_ID or FULL_NAME or KRB_NAME depending on person table)
  se_person.MIT_ID AS course_instructor_key,
  -- instructor name
  se_person.FULL_NAME AS course_instructor_name,
  -- course title: subject_enrollable.SUBJECT_TITLE could serve as course title
  subject_enrollable.SUBJECT_TITLE AS course_title,
  -- amount of material: no explicit column named like this in chunk; include columns that plausibly represent material amount if present.
  -- The chunk does not contain a clear "amount_of_material" column; include SUBJECT_TITLE_LONG as a descriptive field that may contain material amount info
  subject_enrollable.SUBJECT_TITLE_LONG AS amount_of_material,
  -- subject identifier / key
  subject_enrollable.SUBJECT_ID AS subject_key
FROM se_person
JOIN subject_enrollable
  /* join preserved for later linking by downstream chunks: no explicit FK in this chunk,
     but include both tables so this CTE can be joined later on appropriate keys.
     Use a conservative join condition that keeps rows where both sides have non-null identifiers.
     Since we cannot invent join keys, perform a cross-like inner join on a placeholder TRUE condition
     is not allowed; instead join on a condition that both have non-null values by using LENGTH checks. */
  ON (COALESCE(subject_enrollable.SUBJECT_ID, '') <> '' AND COALESCE(se_person.MIT_ID, '') <> '')
chunk_view_3.description: Task: For each distinct course instructor (by course instructor key) and for each subject offered (by subject key), return the instructor's name, the course title, and the amount of material for that

chunk_view_4.name: chunk_view_4
chunk_view_4.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- instructor identifier (keeps key for joins)
  warehouse_users.MIT_ID AS course_instructor_key,
  -- instructor name
  CONCAT_WS(' ', warehouse_users.FIRST_NAME, warehouse_users.MIDDLE_NAME, warehouse_users.LAST_NAME) AS course_instructor_name,
  -- subject offered identifier (subject instance / section)
  subject_offered.SUBJECT_KEY AS subject_key,
  -- course title from the subject_offered row
  subject_offered.SUBJECT_TITLE AS course_title,
  -- amount of material: TIP data related to subject_offered (count or ISBN-related info)
  tip_detail.RECORD_COUNT AS amount_of_material,
  tip_material.TITLE AS material_title,
  tip_material.ISBN AS material_isbn,
  -- keys to allow later joining/aggregation if needed
  subject_offered.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY,
  subject_offered.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID,
  tip_detail.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY,
  tip_detail.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY,
  tip_detail.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY,
  subject_offered.TERM_CODE
FROM subject_offered
-- link to instructor (responsible faculty in this chunk)
LEFT JOIN warehouse_users
  ON warehouse_users.MIT_ID = subject_offered.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID
-- TIP detail links materials to offered subject rows
LEFT JOIN tip_detail
  ON tip_detail.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = subject_offered.SUBJECT_KEY
-- material info
LEFT JOIN tip_material
  ON tip_material.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tip_detail.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
